name: Omdura Judge of Souls
body:
A judge of souls is an officer of her religion, charged with the spiritual well-being of the flock and the punishment of those who are guilty towards the church.

Divine Office

A judge of souls is granted the power from one inquisitorial office (see Legendary Inquisitors). She can also select the Judgment and Executions office with this ability.

This replaces invocation, commune, improved invocation, commune 2/day, and greater invocation.
